method: File-description pages and Commons imageinfo metadata checked; image licences, not Commons structured-data licence. Selected thumbnails visually inspected. No crop or pixel edits; Commons resize retained. Batch 1 (2026-10-24): imageinfo file-licence metadata checked, all 30 full frames visually inspected; optimised progressive JPEGs, maximum 960-pixel longest edge. See docs/knowledge-images-batch-1.json.
